title: [GMCP 203.030.M] Mastery: Supply-chain integrity and server/package trust
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-030-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: Every install resolves immutable package identity, source, version, digest, signature/provenance, license, SBOM, vulnerabilities, maintainer and runtime before execution. Lockfiles and trusted publishers prevent substitution and dependency confusion; updates are staged, rescanned, diffed and rollbackable; revoked or newly critical artifacts are quarantined; and offline verification uses retained transparency evidence. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
